# OSCAL JSON schema 1.2.3

`oscal_complete_schema-1.2.3.json` is NIST's OSCAL complete JSON schema, release v1.2.3, from
https://github.com/usnistgov/OSCAL/releases/download/v1.2.3/oscal_complete_schema.json
(SHA-256 `384324105c7a817af0f65b120a963146caa0e0d55d969cf0daf60e063b87a206`). NIST's work is in
the public domain. The tests validate every OSCAL export against it (spec 071); it is not shipped
in the engine.
